notes.title: Wizlite First Major Update is Live! Annual “5dims Sale” – Up to 55% Off on Steam
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Tokyo, Japan – May 27, 2025 (JST) – [/b][/h3]To mark the month of May (a nod to its name), Japanese indie studio 5dims Inc. is launching the annual “5dims Sale” on Steam. From May 27, three original titles — Wizlite: Everybody Loved RPGs, Lost Between the Lines, and B.I.N.D. — are up to 55% off for one week.
At the same time, Wizlite receives its first major update (v0.60) since its Early Access launch. Based on player feedback, this update adds numerous new features that enhance strategic depth and replayability.

Sale Duration: May 27 – June 3, 2025 (JST)

[h3][b]Featured Discounts:[/b][/h3]
 - Wizlite: Everybody Loved RPGs – 25% off: $19.99 → $14.99 
   (Steam: Wizlite_Everybody_loved_RPGs)
 - Lost Between the Lines – 55% off: $14.99 → $6.74
   (Steam:Lost_Between_the_Lines)
 - B.I.N.D. – 55% off: $14.99 → $6.74
   (Steam: BIND）
*Prices may vary by region and exchange rates

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125041/0ef2d34b972ee8ee466753060aaa14cbc5c565a4.jpg[/img]
 
[h3][b]What’s New in Version 0.60[/b][/h3]
This update directly incorporates player feedback, significantly enhancing strategic depth and rewarding replayability. Dive into improved mechanics that make each run more compelling:
Major New Features
●	Floor 6: Challenge yourself with new traps and unique enemies.
●	Supply Drops: Earn bonus items based on your previous expedition.
●	Corpse Retrieval: Reclaim up to 50% of your gold from the place of your defeat.
●	New “Dispel” command: Expand tactical options for Priest-type characters.
●	Buy-back system: Previously sold items can reappear, enriching your strategies.
●	New gear and magic: Elemental weapons and additional attack spells available now.
●	Terrain cards: Navigate new challenges, like "Rockfall Blockage," affecting your teleportation strategy.
●	Enhanced Stat Tracking: View total runs, kills, highest floors reached, and highest score.
●	New power-up items and spell scrolls expand late-game options.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125041/a85cad2cc3ff2818d3e67cc118d4cd6804c267ea.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]System & Balance Tweaks[/b][/h3]
●	Easier access to advanced jobs.
●	Expanded dungeon maps with guaranteed caravan appearances before bosses.
●	Adjust equipment mid-battle.
●	Reduced negative stat rolls at level-ups.
●	Swap weapons mid-battle for on-the-fly tactics.
●	Higher caravan resurrection rates, emphasizing Vitality (VIT).
●	Improved drop rates for rare (★★★★★) items.
●	Safer positioning for rear-line characters.
This update includes many additional improvements and bug fixes. Full patch notes are available via the Steam page.
Why Play Wizlite Now?
Save 25 % this week and experience Version 0.60’s new depth—there’s never been a better time to dive in.

[h3][b]About Wizlite[/b][/h3]
Wizlite combines nostalgic turn-based RPG combat with dynamic roguelite elements to create a fast-paced, strategic roguelite experience with high replayability.
With short 15-minute dungeon runs and deep party customization, Wizlite delivers a fresh yet familiar experience for fans of classic RPGs.

notes.title: 5dims Inc.'s new game “Wizlite” in development for early access 2024 release!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=f_r0QVXTWkU;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2866960/Wizlite_Everybody_loved_RPGs/]Wish list registration for “Wizlite” is now open![/url]

[b]A classical RPG that can be played in just 15 minutes per round![/b]

“Wizlite” is a nostalgic yet new RPG that combines the combat of traditional command battles with the popular roguelite system.

You’ll find yourself sweating over battles and unlocking treasure chests, deliberating whether to advance or take a rest while checking your remaining health and spell count. Enjoy the tension similar to the classical RPG masterpiece “Wizardry,” but with the crisp and speedy feel unique to roguelites.


Gameplay Flow:

[list]
[*] First, create your character! Choose a race like humans or elves, allocate bonus points to parameters, select a class (profession) and personality, and finally, decide on a name to create your character. Too much hassle? Of course, default characters are also available.

[*] Form a party of up to six characters and start your adventure! That’s what you’d want to do, but initially, there are restrictions on the number of characters you can organize. Play repeatedly to unlock various “power up” and gradually increase what you can do.

[*] The dungeon consists of multiple floors, and players control their party to slowly progress towards defeating the final boss that dwells on the lowest level. You can choose your next action on each floor from three cards, but the card you want may not always be an option.

[*] If all party members become incapacitated, it’s game over. In this roguelite game, if you’re wiped out, everything essentially resets. All characters’ levels return to 1, and any equipment obtained is lost. However, you can make gradual progress by using certain “power up” and special events.
[/list]


Prologue

The group finally found the old facility they were searching for. A rusty iron plate, likely once a sign, lay on the floor at the entrance, its text barely legible in places.

　Wizlite is the oldest and best M******** game!
　Fo** a party, explor* the dungeon infested by mons****,
　Def** the dragon dwel**ng on the bottom **or, and **...

"Disgusting. Is this really the best game?" someone remarked. "It's ancient, so it's bound to be worn out. Besides, it's the oldest, too." "Let's just go in. That's why we're here." "I was dragged here against my will..."

Despite their differing personalities, the group ventured inside together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125041/9cd4d34a22fcbb8c7b3d4c9b8114dcd029de0b05.jpg[/img]

[b]■Promotional Movie[/b]
[previewyoutube=qmHJsEA04Zo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]■Story[/b]
Your love interest is Rion Suzumiya, a classmate with a reputation for being cool and intelligent. She usually keeps her distance from her classmates, but for some reason, she asks you out on a date!
What secret does Rion have that will eventually be revealed?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125041/8cc434c2b7214405d9ee64bd58e63f7003d287b9.jpg[/img]

[b]■Main character:Suzumiya Rion[/b]
Rion is a classy, serious, and studious high school girl!
She is the most popular madonna in the school, and she is rapidly approaching you, with whom she has little contact!　However, she sometimes looks lonely .......
When her secret is revealed, their love begins!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125041/861c422aeb68dafa9bb4b86b85689408c87307a4.jpg[/img]
[b]【Voice: Hikaru Ueda】[/b]
Some of Rion's lines are performed by popular voice actress Hikaru Ueda. 
Her cute voice adds color to the love story.


[b]■Game system[/b]
This is a simple visual novel game.
Depending on the choices that appear here and there in the story, the distance between you and the heroine changes!　The story branches off into one of five different endings accordingly.
Restart the game again and again to complete all the endings!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125041/70e9fb7dd185b159b542d35891567512f86b515c.jpg[/img]
